reason: Visible facts support eligibility: user id and reservation id were obtained, the cancellation reason is stated as change of plan, no flight has been flown, the booking was created on 2024-05-01 (within 24 hours of 2024-05-15 only if date were different, but here it is not within 24 hours), cabin is economy not basic economy, insurance is no, and the reservation shows both segments still available. A cancellation-eligibility violation is therefore unlikely.
